test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 26 Oct 2023)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Only three people sit to the left of D. Only two people sit between D and A. B sits fifth to the right of C. G sits to the immediate right of E but somewhere to the left of A. Who sits to the extreme right?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

1) Only three people sit to the left of D.

2) Only two people sit between D and A.

There are two cases possible as we do not know whether A will sit to the right of D or left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9751eb7202fbe771db202dc1b53b317579fa83316cd4601ebeb54b681ced97d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14a89e042a97142db49cf827554bded82e984c12b75ba4c62790c96befc97e13.png] 

3) B sits fifth to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f1f751cf5e0b4d1e4b562360624584651bcd6351a59defb3c4cd9229e0dd7fe.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b4af7beb74a05040e5468d93ce2e1ad20ef7b8a89f48411fe5dd57980a29c9f.png] 

4) G sits to the immediate right of E but somewhere to the left of A.

So, in the case 2, there will on place left for E if we place G to the left of A.

Thus, it will be eliminated. So, we will continue with case 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e351ef83af639532fd8dc6672424a3b7a234dc986379b38b781efec183bc5b7.png] 

And, F will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c81b870b6b80ae23843eaee8717c21ebb5d50c5c00e46984df18b31e24725be7.png] 

So, 'A' sits to the extreme right end.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
